title: Unramified morphism of schemes
statement: A morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-pc-scheme] is *unramified* if it is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and its diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ into the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. (By Stacks Lemma 02GE, parts (1) and (2), this is the notion of Stacks Definition 02G4, where $f$ is unramified if it is covered by affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $R\to A$ of finite type and $\Omega_{A/R}=0$.)

source.place: Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma with Tag 02GE and Definition with Tag 02G4
